noncomputable def VTask.sumLexLift {α₁ : Type*} {α₂ : Type*} {β₁ : Type*} {β₂ : Type*} 
  {γ₁ : Type*} {γ₂ : Type*} (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂)
  (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) :
  α₁ ⊕ α₂ → β₁ ⊕ β₂ → Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := 
  fun a b =>
    if a.1 < a.2 then 
      if b.1 < b.2 then 
        (f₁ a.1 b.1).image (fun c => ⟨c, Sum.inl⟩)
      else 
        (g₁ a.1 b.2).image (fun c => ⟨c, Sum.inl⟩) ∪ (g₂ a.1 b.2).image (fun c => ⟨c, Sum.inr⟩)
    else 
      if b.1 < b.2 then 
        (g₂ a.2 b.1).image (fun c => ⟨c, Sum.inr⟩) ∪ (g₁ a.2 b.1).image (fun c => ⟨c, Sum.inl⟩)
      else 
        (f₂ a.2 b.2).image (fun c => ⟨c, Sum.inr⟩)
